title: Cell complexes, fundamental groups and covering spaces
description: Cell complexes, fundamental groups and covering spaces as used by the courses on group rings and classifying spaces: homotopy equivalences of cell complexes, trees, triangulations and simplicial approximation; fundamental groups of graphs and of complexes with attached cells, presentation complexes; universal covers with lifted cells and deck transformations, covers for normal subgroups, and cellular chains over the group ring with the Cayley complex.

units.title: Fundamental groups of graphs and two-complexes

prerequisites: core course Algebraic Topology (D60), edition with Roberts's lectures and Fomberg's components: Lecture 4 Definition 4.4; Lecture 5 Theorem 5.1 and Corollary 5.3; Lecture 6 Definition 6.2; Lecture 7 Proposition 7.1, Definition 7.1, Lemma 7.1 and Corollary 7.1; Lecture 9 Corollaries 9.1 and 9.4; Lecture 10 Theorem 10.1 and Corollary 10.1; Lecture 12 Example 12.2 and Corollary 12.1; Lecture 16 Definition 16.1, Propositions 16.1 and 16.2 and Corollary 16.1; Lecture 17 Lemma 17.1; Lecture 18 Lemma 18.2 and Proposition 18.2; Fomberg component 7 (lemma on skeleta, cellular homology theorem (14.1)-(14.2), incidence formula with (15.3)); Fomberg Theorem 1.13 and Corollary 1.14

programme course Characteristic classes (DG-CHAR): lesson Grassmannians and classifying maps (DG-CHAR-03), Section 7 (Lemma 7.1, product of a quotient map with the interval, Lemma 7.2) and Theorem 8.3 with the paragraph after its proof; lesson Frame fields and primary obstructions (DG-CHAR-08B), Lemma A.1 and its proof, homotopy extension in Section E, Lemma E.1
programme course Van Kampen diagrams (van-kampen-diagrams): lesson Words, free groups and Cayley graphs (Lemmas 1.1, 1.2, 3.1, 3.3, Definition 4.1, Lemma 4.2, Exercise 5.2)
